property_summary: For any caller and any hash, the reference contract requires lockInGuess to be called with exactly 1 ether (so a payable call of 1 ether succeeds) while a call with 0 ether must revert; the mutant accepts 0 ether so there exist inputs (calling with 0 ether) that make the mutant behave differently (succeed) while the reference reverts.
change_summary: Require msg.value to be 0 instead of 1 ether, so callers need not send 1 ether and stored guess/block differ after call.
